about.p1: I am <1>Francisco Pandol</1> — a <2>Software Project Leader and Backend Tech Lead</2> with <3>over ten years</3> owning architecture and delivery in <4>fintech, crypto, and real-time systems</4>. I lead with <5>Python (Django, FastAPI) and Node.js (NestJS)</5>, and I am comfortable making the calls that affect scalability, latency, and operational safety — the same profile that matters for large product and payments platforms.
about.p2: I have led teams on the <1>Mercado Libre ecosystem</1> (RealTrends), shipped exchange-grade backends with custody (Fireblocks) and KYC/AML integrations, and improved platform performance at scale (including significant gains on wealth-management workloads). More recently I've built Gemini-powered AI agent workflows and used Claude Code to automate engineering work across a production codebase. I stay close to code and reviews while aligning engineering with business outcomes.

aws-infra-report.name: AWS Infra Report
aws-infra-report.problem: Cloud accounts accumulate idle resources, open security groups, and opaque networking — waste and risk that are hard to see without hours of console clicking.
aws-infra-report.solution: Built a read-only Python auditor with boto3 that maps VPC/compute topology into an interactive Mermaid diagram, ranks findings (CRITICAL→LOW) with copy-pasteable aws CLI fixes, and estimates monthly cost waste.
aws-infra-report.impact: Shows production AWS fluency — networking, ECS, ELB, RDS, CloudWatch — packaged as a single-file, shareable HTML report teams can run without granting write access.

unofficial-mural-python-client.name: MURAL Python Client
unofficial-mural-python-client.problem: Integrating with the MURAL Public API from Python meant hand-rolling OAuth, pagination, and untyped JSON for dozens of endpoints.
unofficial-mural-python-client.solution: Shipped a typed SDK covering the OpenAPI surface: Pydantic v2 models, OAuth2 with auto-refresh, transparent cursor pagination, a Typer CLI, and a full exception hierarchy.
unofficial-mural-python-client.impact: Demonstrates library-grade API design — client-side validation, 98+ mocked tests at ~99% coverage — the same patterns used for reliable third-party integrations in production backends.

lebenslauf-generator.name: CV Generator
lebenslauf-generator.problem: Professionals need portable, version-controlled CVs that render consistently across formats — without locking content into proprietary tools.
lebenslauf-generator.solution: Built an open-source CLI and in-browser app: Pydantic validates the JSON source, Jinja2 renders it, WeasyPrint exports PDF, and a Pyodide-powered web app runs the whole pipeline client-side with no server.
lebenslauf-generator.impact: Demonstrates end-to-end Python tooling — schema validation, templating, PDF generation — plus WebAssembly delivery for zero-dependency distribution.
